summary: Metadata-only consolidation of GT23 events and frames for all 26 publisher activities (the backlog's 19 = the base tasks with publisher Segmentation files; 7 more are unsegmented). Events: 6 activities are per-leg heel-strike cycles (20 N plate threshold, 50 N treadmill running; skip ignores the mid-stride heel strike; README 272-274), 2 are plate-pass windows (toe-off before to heel strike after the plates: cutting, tire_run), 11 are pelvis- or trunk-velocity task windows (transfers, not leg events), 7 have no source events (continuous only). Parsing files hold start/end only; toe-off is not in them. turn_and_step's definition conflicts (README vs author plot titles 'segmented by toe off'). Frames: vertical GRF Y up and positive support are established; horizontal GRF/global CoP are lab X/Z that turn with the person, so forward needs a heading: measurable for forward walking (CORE-04 pelvis facing), undefined for 15 activities (D-GT23-C01-1: A facing everywhere, B direction of travel as the current rule reads literally, C forward walking only, or defer). Sideways sign is already decided (outward per leg). Converter CoP is in the calcn body frame, a frame mismatch with the data reference's ground-frame CoP. Joint sagittal signs under rule B (hip +1, knee -1, ankle +1; powers +1) are source-supported for all activities and data-reproduced only in CORE-04's 7 gait conditions. Segment angles unsupported; kinetics blocked by D-GT23-C04-1. Converter findings F1-F6: the phase export drops the second leg (498 gait cycles in running and stairs; 4948 intervals overall, plus 127 hop contact intervals; most of the rest possibly duplicate whole-body windows), the time export merges all fields of a parsing file into one window, an unused LocoHub GRF fallback segmentation with absolute 600/400 N thresholds exists, running and skipping are labelled level_walking, and curb/step-up heights are invented (stair rise is 152 mm per paper Table 1). Event validity stays 'source_defined_unverified' until probe P1-P3 runs. Round 2 (verifier back_to_worker): decision option set rebuilt, probe P2 now covers hop, counts and notes corrected.

decisions.question: Our sign rule defines forward (+x) as the walking direction. In GaTech 2023, 15 of 26 activities have no single forward walk (backward walking, side shuffle, squats, sit-to-stand, lifts, jumps, lunges, turns, cutting, meander and others). What should forward mean there for forward and sideways ground force and centre of pressure?

options.label: The person's facing direction in every activity
options.consequence: Forward and sideways force and pressure filled for all 26 activities from pelvis facing measured per window; windows without a steady facing left out; the sign-rule wording is extended for all datasets. Reversible.

options.label: The direction of travel (the current rule read literally)
options.consequence: Filled for the 13 activities with steady travel: forward walking plus backward walking and side shuffle, where forward force is opposite or sideways to the person's facing while joint angles stay in the facing frame. The other 13 (in place or turning) keep lab-axis values only. Reversible.

options.label: Forward walking only
options.consequence: Filled for the 11 forward-walking activities (curb_down, curb_up, dynamic_walk, incline_walk, normal_walk, obstacle_walk, stairs, start_stop, step_ups, tire_run, weighted_walk) from the measured heading; the other 15, including meander (turning heading), keep lab-axis values only. Reversible.

decisions.options_order: By GaTech 2023 activities with forward and sideways values: 26, 13, 11.
decisions.why: In forward walking, facing and travel agree, so forward is unambiguous and matches the frame used for joint angles. Travel splits force from the angle frame in backward walking and side shuffle, and facing needs a new rule for turning and in-place tasks that would bind every dataset.
decisions.check: Decision sheet figure: in the backward-walking example the blue facing arrow and the orange travel arrow point opposite ways.
decisions.cost_of_waiting: GaTech 2023 forward and sideways force and pressure stay out of any release (lab values kept); vertical force, joint angles and other datasets are unaffected.
